title: Elephant Caravan at Sunrise
description: A vibrant stained-glass style scene depicts a line of armored elephants with riders marching through a vast field of purple lavender and red poppies. A radiant sun with golden rays dominates the sky above, while a giant white lily flower stands prominently in the foreground to the right.
prompt: A highly detailed stained glass window featuring a procession of armored war elephants with riders marching through rolling hills of purple lavender and bright red poppies. A massive glowing sun with golden rays fills the top of the composition. A giant white lily flower stands in the right foreground. Vibrant colors, intricate lead lines, rich luminous glass textures, fantasy surreal scene.
